brand.badge: AI form autofill for Indian portals

brand.pointExtract: Details extracted from photos and PDFs
brand.pointReview: Nothing is submitted without your review

customers.title: Customers
customers.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, mobile, customer code, village or district
customers.name: Name
customers.duplicateWarning: This looks like an existing customer
customers.duplicateHelp: Check before creating a second record for the same person.
customers.confirmDelete: Delete this customer? This can be reversed by a manager.
customers.editHelp: Change any field below and save. Leaving a field blank keeps its current value — it will not be cleared.
customers.editKeepEncrypted: Leave blank to keep the saved value
customers.editSetEncrypted: Leave blank if none, or type a value to save

paste.title: Add customer details
paste.help: Paste a customer’s details as text — from a portal, an email, a spreadsheet or a message. Assistigo reads it into profile fields. Nothing is saved until you review it.
paste.placeholder:
Name: Amit Kumar
Father’s Name: Ram Kumar
Date of Birth: 14/08/1996
Mobile: 9900012345
District: Ghazipur
paste.privacyNote: The pasted text is read and discarded — it is not stored. Aadhaar numbers are removed automatically; only the last four digits are kept.
paste.readLines: Found {fields} fields in {lines} lines. Check each one before saving.
paste.noFields: No profile fields could be read from this text. Try one detail per line, like “Mobile: 9900012345”.
paste.prefillHelp: Paste the customer’s details and Assistigo will fill this form. Check every value before saving.
paste.prefillExtra: {count} more details were found — paste the same text on the profile after saving to add them.
paste.uploadIntro: Upload an ID, certificate or marksheet. Assistigo reads it and proposes profile fields the same way pasted text does.
paste.uploadedHelp: Assistigo is reading it now. It will appear in Documents below — review and save the details from there once reading finishes.

settings.title: Settings

settings.lastOwner: An organization must keep at least one owner.

descriptions.viewer: Read-only access to customers and applications.
descriptions.billing_admin: Manages the plan and invoices. No access to customer data.
